notes.title: Roadmap Update & Demo Incoming!
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Welcome again skyward adventurers![/b][/h1][p]We know you're eager to get your hands on our explosive bullet heaven action, and today's news post is all about our development journey, where we are now, and what's coming very, very soon![/p][p][/p][h2][b]Our Development Process[/b][/h2][p]Developing [i]Skyfire: Death From Above[/i] has been an incredible journey, guided by a clear and structured roadmap. We believe in transparency and want to give you a peek behind the curtain at how we're bringing this game to life.[/p][p][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640167/4829b90c25ea88c0d22bee2edff2b5f7d9d0d42d.png"][/img][/h3][h3][b]Milestone 0: Laying the Foundation[/b][/h3][p]This was our initial ideation phase, where the design team put forth the core concepts for [i]Skyfire[/i]. We sketched first designs, the various enemies you'll face, and the unique abilities your aerial citadel will wield. It was also crucial to get those very first, rough prototypes of the game's core loop up and running – is it fun? Is it engaging? This early stage was all about answering those fundamental questions.[/p][h3][b]Milestone 1: Mechanics Taking Shape[/b][/h3][p]Building on our core loop, this milestone saw us create a "playground" environment. This wasn't about pretty graphics yet, but about solidifying the foundational mechanics: how your platforms move, how turrets function, and how simple enemies behave. We also started bringing our concepts into 3D, creating the first basic models, and crucially, finalized the core loop design – deciding exactly what the player's moment-to-moment experience would be.[/p][h3][b]Milestone 2: Defining the Aesthetic & Core Gameplay[/b][/h3][p]This was a pivotal milestone for the game's identity. We created an artistic diorama, a small, highly polished scene, to truly lock down the final visual aesthetic and art style of [i]Skyfire[/i]. Simultaneously, our programmers fully implemented and refined the core loop, ensuring it was robust and expandable. This also marked the beginning of proper level design, moving beyond simple test environments.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640167/6cec6000e76e826ce086d5a667ca42ef0a2490c9.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Milestone 3: Expanding the Battlefield[/b][/h3][p]With the core gameplay locked and the art style defined, this milestone focused on content expansion. We began designing and making multiple levels fully playable, introducing a wider array of abilities and upgrades for your turrets and platforms, and adding more turret types to diversify your defensive strategies. This was also when the very first pieces of [i]final[/i] in-game art started to make their way into the game, replacing placeholder assets.[/p][h3][b]Milestone 4: Boss Battles & Polish Begins[/b][/h3][p]A significant challenge in this phase was adding our first boss level, designing a unique and formidable foe that would test your accumulated skills. We also focused on bringing the first full level (Level 1) to its final art pass, ensuring it looked as incredible as we envisioned. More upgrades and enemy variations were introduced, and a comprehensive tutorial was implemented to welcome new pilots into the fight.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Current Status: Diving Deep into Milestone 5![/b][/h2][p]As of now, we are in the thick of [b]Milestone 5[/b], the final push towards a truly polished and immersive experience. This is where all the disparate pieces come together, and we refine every detail. Our focus during this crucial period includes:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640167/3e53a621cdcd5e196ef496eef4aebdc505a859f6.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Get Ready to Take Flight! Demo Release on July 11th![/b][/h2][p][/p][p][b]Mark your calendars, wishlist the game, and prepare for takeoff![/b] We can't wait for you to experience [i]Skyfire: Death From Above[/i] firsthand.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Follow us below to be part of the Little Donkey Family[/b]🫏[/h3][p][/p][h3][b]With much love, [/b][/h3][p]Skyfire: Death From Above Dev Team[/p][p]
[/p]
